title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 2 team identity + real logos
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: The live Top Picks card owner renders away/home abbreviations inside styled boxes instead of real team logos, and ranked rows do not carry canonical logo provenance fields.
root_cause: The frozen Top Picks ranking engine emits team names/abbreviations only. Existing certified CFB exact-ID and multi-source logo resolvers were never connected to the ranked Top-10 handoff.
patch: After frozen ranking completes, enrich only the final Top-10 rows with exact ESPN team IDs and real logo URLs. Use the certified exact-ID resolver first and the independent existing multi-source logo resolver only as fallback. Render real img elements in the shared compact-card owner inherited by V3/V4/V5.

repair.exact_failure: baseline logo-placeholder audit no longer matches live owner
repair.root_cause: Step-1 permanent guard incorrectly required the audited baseline defects to remain present in live product code. Step 2 is explicitly responsible for closing the logo-placeholder defect.
repair.patch: Make Step 1 verify the immutable baseline findings stored in its frozen contract instead of requiring later product owners to remain broken.

browser_selector_repair.root_cause: The prefix selector also matched the board container data-testid=cfb-top-picks-card-board, so the verifier counted 10 articles plus 1 container.
browser_selector_repair.patch: Scope the count to article[data-testid^='cfb-top-picks-card-'] so only actual ranked pick cards are counted.

ci_isolation_repair.exact_failure: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'streamlit' during permanent-contract pytest collection
ci_isolation_repair.root_cause: The lightweight permanent-contract lane installs pytest only, but the Step-2 runtime test imported Streamlit product modules at collection time.
ci_isolation_repair.patch: Use a lightweight static Step-2 guard test in permanent CI. Keep full product/runtime/card tests in the dedicated Step-2 browser workflow that restores the complete hot browser environment.

browser_image_timing_repair.independent_probe: ESPN team-logo asset confirmed reachable and valid
browser_image_timing_repair.root_cause: The Playwright verifier measured naturalWidth/naturalHeight immediately after DOM render without waiting for cross-origin image decode/load completion.
browser_image_timing_repair.patch: Wait up to 10 seconds per logo for positive natural dimensions before failing closed.
